title: ELSET Reports & Analytics

navigation.label: Reports & Analytics
navigation.compatibility: Existing root-route section state remains supported. Existing job, invoice, customer and maintenance record routes are reused.

capabilitiesInspected.jobs: Stored creation dates, current status, urgency, schedule, customer/site address, maintenance links and assigned technician. No reliable general completion/status event history.
capabilitiesInspected.customersAndSites: Current customer IDs/types/creation dates and embedded sites; report links use existing customer and site relationships.
capabilitiesInspected.financials: Actual invoice rows, canonical invoice line arithmetic, payment amount cents/dates, sent counts and inactive/archive eligibility.
capabilitiesInspected.maintenance: Recurrence segments, occurrence exceptions, generated/completed job relationships, active state, next due dates, per-visit contract prices and default technician.
capabilitiesInspected.jobCosting: Separate add-on-owned cost entries and canonical job summary, including category totals, integer cents, negative profit and zero-revenue margins.
capabilitiesInspected.inventory: Current quantities, unit costs and reorder thresholds exist; no stock-movement history used to invent turnover or historical inventory metrics.
capabilitiesInspected.staff: Stored assignment IDs/names. Same-name staff remain separate. A narrow server projection avoids the legacy workspace normalizer clearing assignments.
capabilitiesInspected.accountingMappings: Existing provider mappings and payment ownership remain unchanged. Reports use local ELSET invoices/payments, never live QuickBooks or Xero queries.

customers: Average invoiced value per invoiced customer
maintenance: Sum of active per-visit contract prices

deliberatelyUnsupported: Jobs completed over time: current completed count is shown instead; updatedAt is never treated as a general completion timestamp.
Completion duration, status dwell time and technician speed/productivity: no general event history.
Quote acceptance/conversion rate: no reliable acceptance event history.
Historical outstanding-balance comparisons: current balances are snapshots, not a reconstructed ledger.
Average days to payment is not published as a settlement-history metric.
Locality/suburb ranking is not inferred from unstructured address strings.
No staff performance ranking from costs, no inventory turnover history, and no annualized contract revenue invented from per-visit prices.

dateFiltering.storage: React Router query parameters: range/from/to/tab/compare/report and relevant customer/site/technician/status/type filters. Dates persist across tabs, reload and record drill-down return paths.
dateFiltering.currentPresets: Current week/month/quarter/year end today. Week starts Monday. Last month is the completed calendar month; last 12 months is rolling.
dateFiltering.comparison: Immediately preceding contiguous period with the same inclusive day count. Only dated metrics compare. Zero baseline displays New or No change, not Infinity.
dateFiltering.financialBasis: Invoiced by issue date; cash received by payment date even for older invoices. Outstanding and aging use current per-invoice balances at the displayed snapshot date across all issue dates.
dateFiltering.jobBasis: Creation-date trend; current status/urgency/assignments are explicitly labeled all-date snapshots.
dateFiltering.customerBasis: New customers by creation date; invoiced/received ranking uses its respective period; lifetime reports explicitly use all dates.
dateFiltering.maintenanceBasis: Schedule report expands selected due dates. Forecast starts today for 12 calendar months. Next-due KPIs and contract prices are current snapshots. Technician filtering uses plan defaults independently of generated jobs.
dateFiltering.profitabilityBasis: Jobs invoiced in range; unbilled jobs use creation dates. All recorded costs for those selected jobs are included. Charts group job cohorts, not expense-ledger recognition.
dateFiltering.invalidRanges: Explicit validation prevents misleading totals and exports.

chartTypes: Daily/weekly/monthly time series with empty periods retained

reports.name: Maintenance Contract Value
reports.basis: Active plans · price per visit, not annual revenue

reports.name: Job Profitability
reports.basis: Invoice issue date; unbilled jobs by creation date · all recorded job costs, ex GST

reports.name: Cost Breakdown
reports.basis: Selected job cohort · all recorded job costs, ex GST

reports.name: Gross Margin
reports.basis: Costed jobs in selected cohort · ex GST

exports.csv: Filtered rows only; headers, UTF-8 BOM, CRLF, proper comma/quote/newline escaping, numeric money values, ISO dates, formula-safe user text, report/date-range filename.
exports.print: Browser Print / Save as PDF; landscape styling, report/date/filter context, full-width table, repeated print headers and hidden navigation. No PDF dependency added.

drillDown: Customer, job, invoice and maintenance table links use existing routes and return context.
Revenue/creation chart points open the report for that date bucket.
Job pipeline bars open Job History with the selected status.
Returning from a job refreshes the reporting read, including costing edits.

financialReconciliation.arithmetic: Server invoiceFinancialsFromRows operates on canonical line/payment integer cents. Customer account and reporting share isCustomerAccountInvoice eligibility. Job profitability reuses summarizeJobCosting.
financialReconciliation.exclusions: Unissued drafts, void/cancelled/deleted/archived/invalid invoices follow customer account eligibility; physical archives are outside live invoice queries. Payments are joined by invoice ID once.
financialReconciliation.overpayments: Each outstanding balance is clamped per invoice. A credit on one invoice does not settle another. Invoiced minus received plus per-invoice overpayments equals outstanding for a common invoice cohort.
financialReconciliation.costing: Ex GST revenue and recorded direct costs. Uncosted invoices are listed and excluded from aggregate margins; zero-revenue margins are null and losses remain signed.

performance.access: Read-only SQLite transaction with existing admin/office authentication and role middleware; no-store; disabled Job Costing data is withheld.
performance.queries: Fixed maximum of eight reads, not one query or HTTP request per chart/job. No full workspace reconstruction, photos or documents in the reporting payload.
performance.client: Memoized selectors, indexed/grouped lookups, binary bucket lookup, tab-only chart rendering and a lazy-loaded Recharts workspace. Cost details are returned only for jobs with actual entries.

benchmark.note: Synthetic in-memory SQLite, local Node 24 on Windows; seven medians after warmup, no production traffic. Full workspace load occurs only in benchmark fixture setup.

responsive.chrome: Sticky toolbar with sticky tabs in the same top region
responsive.desktop: 2:1 lead row and touching two-column cells
responsive.mobile: Single column; local KPI/tab/table scrolling; no page-level horizontal overflow
responsive.themes: Shared light/dark/data-view theme tokens; existing roundedEdges preference; presets verified

coverage: All seven tabs in light/dark themes at all four viewports
Financial totals and real assignment projection
Existing record routes and return state
Read failure/retry without invented zero metrics
No per-chart requests or successful-save full resync

remainingOpportunities: Explicit completion/status/quote-acceptance event history for trustworthy duration and conversion metrics
Audited historical receivables and settlement snapshots
Server aggregation/pagination for very large report tables and ledgers; current snapshot endpoint loads required financial rows once
Saved report configurations or scheduled exports if requested
